low_support_exact_closure.complete_sum: on the regular affine locus the sum is a full nontrivial F_p^* character sum with at most O_m(1) PGL2 coordinate values deleted, hence O_m(1)
low_support_exact_closure.order_free_status: this closes the degenerate selector cases without using the y^0,...,y^{d-1} ladder and with constants independent of d
low_support_exact_closure.support_size_0: all residues vanish; this is a d-th power case and is excluded by the Kummer nonpower hypothesis
low_support_exact_closure.support_size_1: impossible on P^1 because the divisor degree is zero modulo d
low_support_exact_closure.support_size_2: after a PGL2 change sending the two visible branches to 0 and infinity, f=c*phi(x)^e*h(x)^d with e not congruent 0 mod d

plain_conclusion: 阶无关 Kummer 签名选择器没有整体闭合，但本轮把唯一内部自足剩余继续压窄：先把分支残基放到投影直线 P^1 上，证明可见支撑小于三的退化情形不需要 Stepanov selector。支撑为零是 d 次幂而被排除；投影支撑为一与除子次数零矛盾；投影支撑为二可经 PGL2 变成 `c*phi(x)^e*h(x)^d`，仿射完整和退化为 `F_p^*` 上的非平凡角色和删去至多 `O_m(1)` 个坐标值，因而只有 `O_m(1)` 边界项，常数不依赖角色阶 `d`。因此真正剩余从笼统的 `OrderFreeKummerSignatureSelectorAndHasseJetRankLemma` 缩成 `ThreeVisibleBranchOrderFreeJetPivotLemma`：只需处理至少三处投影可见分支的非退化残基图，构造阶无关 pivot 族并证明 Hasse-jet 秩下界。未完成该三分支 pivot 引理前，Stepanov、Kummer 迹界、Burgess B4 与行/列命题仍不能作者侧无条件闭合。

projective_support_normal_form.constant_factor: a nonzero constant only multiplies the complete character sum by chi(c), so it is irrelevant to the rank gate
projective_support_normal_form.d_power_quotient: multiplying f by a d-th power changes no character value and removes invisible branch coordinates
projective_support_normal_form.degree_zero_constraint: sum_v ord_v(f)=0, hence a non-dth-power residue pattern cannot have exactly one projective visible branch
projective_support_normal_form.scope_gain: the selector problem only needs projective visible support size at least three
projective_support_normal_form.support_definition: work on P^1 and include infinity; visible support S={v: ord_v(f) not congruent 0 mod d}

rejected_shortcuts.finite_audit: the finite PGL2 audit records the exact low-support map shape only; it is not used as empirical proof of the three-branch gate
rejected_shortcuts.full_d_ladder: using O(d) Kummer powers would reintroduce d-dependent genus/dimension and is still rejected
rejected_shortcuts.generic_position: the proof must allow collisions and special cross-ratios; it cannot assume branch positions are generic
rejected_shortcuts.support_count_only: support size >=3 is necessary for the hard case but does not itself prove Hasse-jet rank independence

remaining_non_degenerate_selector.required_jet_output: prove the Hasse-jet evaluation matrix on that pivot family loses at most C_m*T*N rank
remaining_non_degenerate_selector.required_selector_output: construct a bounded-pole pivot family of size >= c_m*D after Kummer relations, with c_m independent of d,P,chi and branch positions
remaining_non_degenerate_selector.why_not_closed: the corpus still lacks a uniform proof that three visible branch residues force an order-free pivot block for every residue pattern and every branch configuration
remaining_non_degenerate_selector.why_this_is_narrower: all zero-, one-, and two-visible-branch residue patterns are now exact PGL2 degeneracies; only genuine three-branch interaction remains

rows.meaning: 上一证书的唯一剩余确认为阶无关 Kummer 签名选择器与 Hasse-jet 秩问题。
把有限分支残基提升到 P^1，并用 d 次幂商掉不可见坐标。
投影可见支撑小于三的退化情形由 PGL2 单坐标精确求和关闭。
全局 selector 原子已缩窄为三可见分支以上的非退化 jet 枢轴问题。
仍需给出三可见分支下的阶无关 pivot 族和 Hasse-jet 独立性证明。
Hasse-jet 记账接口已固定，但非退化 pivot 块的实际秩下界仍未证明。
低支撑退化已关闭，但完整阶无关 selector 还等待三分支 pivot 引理。
Stepanov-Kummer 非零秩仍等待完整 selector。
Stepanov 完整内部证明仍未闭合。
秩一 Kummer 迹界仍等待 Stepanov rank gate。
本步只缩窄内部自足线，不声明行/列命题作者侧无条件闭合。
